column3: Description

Workshop with sponsor and system owners to confirm JAF-CA scope as a prerequisite platform: classification boundaries, integration touchpoints, service-level expectations, and formal acceptance criteria for infrastructure handover.

Author reference architecture for JAF-CA, JAF-SCM, audit subsystem, CRL/OCSP distribution. Map every component to JSC §4 requirements; document pre-production deviations and production hardening roadmap.
Provision reproducible build/test environment: Python venv, automated pytest harness, systemd unit templates, NGINX CRL/OCSP proxy skeleton, logging standards for operational teams.
Implement sovereign SCM: Scrypt + AES-256-GCM token storage, per-CA logical slots, PKCS#11-compatible session API, append-only audit hooks, migration path to hardware HSM.
Deploy Root CA (20-year profile) and four departmental Issuing CAs (Communications, InfoSys, Personnel, Intel). Certificate profiles: server TLS, personnel, device, client auth, code signing.
CLI & operator tooling
column4: Filesystem PKI layout, secure cert indexing, operator CLI for issuance/revocation, legacy token migration script, trust bundle export API for embedding in applications.

column3: Automated 24-hour CRL rotation for Root and all Issuing CAs; departmental CRL files; NGINX distribution; systemd jaf-crl.service with SCM PIN via secured env file.
HTTP OCSP responder per Issuing CA for real-time good/revoked status — critical for high-availability applications that cannot wait for CRL publication cycles.
SQLite audit DB with tamper triggers (no UPDATE/DELETE on audit log); revocation workflow triggers CRL regeneration; query API for compliance reporting.
Certificate Policy, CPS, compliance matrix, SCM architecture, key ceremony template, automated phase1_signoff_verify.py evidence JSON, full integration test suite.
Prime-order curve search with Montgomery→Weierstrass pipeline, eight JSC security checks, Pari/GP cross-verification, independent audit bundle (reproduce.sh).
C library: Ed448/JAF-ECC-384 keygen, ECDH, ECDSA (SHA-384), parameter sync from JSON, smoke tests, Valgrind scaffold for memory safety baseline.
Python jaf_crypto reference; Go CGo bindings (Keygen, ECDH, Sign, Verify); sdk/test_vectors.json with 55+ cross-language KATs for application QA teams.
Documented backend factory (jaf_scm, pkcs11, jaf_ecc384), issuance/revocation APIs, SDK packaging guide for teams embedding PKI and crypto into their systems.
Full regression: SCM, lifecycle, CRL, OCSP, crypto, SDK vectors; performance baseline; security posture review; failure-mode exercises (revocation, SCM PIN rotation).
Production deployment playbook: SCM env (/etc/jaf-ca/scm.env), network segmentation for CRL/OCSP, backup/recovery, incident response — written for infrastructure ops teams.
Training curriculum delivery: PKI operators, IA staff, application team leads. Hands-on: issue cert, revoke, read audit, consume trust anchor in sample app.
Phase 1 + Phase 2 evidence packages; maintenance recommendations; lessons learned; sponsor sign-off session and formal handover to operations.
Weekly status reports, risk/issue register, change control, sponsor steering meetings, quality gate facilitation across all milestones (entire project duration).
